purpose: Each node of the live gate-park restore scenario, broken in the gateway and observed failing against the production gateway, then restored. The error strings are verbatim from those runs.

nodes.intact: the freed-slot eligibility verdict returns code 'ELIGIBLE_FREED_SLOT_RESTORE'
nodes.mutation: returns 'ELIGIBLE_RESTORE' instead, i.e. the retained verdict

nodes.intact: restoreOne calls reclaimFreedSlot for a freed park
nodes.mutation: the call is removed, so the restore never re-binds the slot
nodes.error: restore did not complete: outcome=failed phase=partial errors=[{"phase":"parked","action":"workspace.reattach","code":"EFFECT_FAILED","message":"slot 'macwork-ff-1' is owned by 'nobody', not 'aee49175-c87c-4b1d-816d-059c7a8a7018'; leaving the detached workspace alone","occurredAt":"2026-09-06T00:19:24.789Z","retryable":true},{"phase":"orchestration-resuming","action":"workspace.reattach","code":"EFFECT_FAILED","message":"the parked branch is still detached; restore cannot complete until it is back in the working tree","occurredAt":"2026-09-06T00:19:24.794Z","retryable":true}]

nodes.intact: the gate-park hold branch suppresses the inherited 'free-slot' choice
nodes.mutation: the suppression is removed, so the restored gate can re-park the run
nodes.error: the restored gate can still inherit free-slot (suppressed=null, generation=0)

inherentNegatives.fencedWhileParked: asserts runtime.posture.apply is REFUSED with FREED_SLOT_RESTORE_REQUIRED; a lifted fence fails the node
inherentNegatives.slotTaken: asserts the preview and run.resolveDecision both refuse with RESTORE_SLOT_TAKEN and that the preview mutated nothing; an accepted restore fails the node
inherentNegatives.parked: observed failing live twice during development when the park's graceful-exit stop misread an exiting worker (recorded in the round-2 report)
